**Finding: TRANSITION — compliant (at/above the preferred position).** No redline proposed.

- **§ 11.1** — obligations trigger "[u]pon expiry or termination for any reason," with up to six months of assistance covering knowledge transfer, export support, replacement-supplier cooperation, migration and continued service at unchanged scope/service levels. Rates are fixed to the expiring Order Form, which is better for us than the preferred "then-current rates" (no uplift exposure) — noted, not flagged.
- **§ 11.2** — return of all Customer Data within thirty days in a complete, commonly used, documented, machine-readable format with relationships and metadata; no withholding for fee disputes. The thirty-day clock runs from our request, a trigger we control.
- **§ 11.3** — certified deletion (authorized officer, in writing) after we confirm successful return, with any law-required copy left protected and unusable — matching the preferred sequencing of deletion after return.
- **§ 16.5** confirms Customer Data stays governed by Sections 11 and 15, so no competing return/destruction mechanic applies, and nothing in the document approaches the walk-away (no data return or immediate deletion).
